config.moduleName: Truly Nordic Ebony Armor and Weapons

plugin.name: ESP version (recommended)
plugin.description: A light plugin (ESL-flagged, it takes no load-order slot) that points vanilla's four ebony armour addon records at this mod's own mesh folder and gives the helmet the open-helm body slots. Nothing else is needed. The Ebony Mail and Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil's Ebony Warrior set are optional SkyPatcher patches on the last page.

plugin.name: No ESP - SkyPatcher
plugin.description: No plugin at all. REQUIRES SkyPatcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/106659), which edits records at game start from text files. The armour and weapons show the same look and keep their stats: the worn meshes sit on vanilla's own ebony paths, and SkyPatcher gives the helmet the open-helm body slots so the head is not hidden. The Ebony Mail and Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil's Ebony Warrior set are optional patches on the last page, with either option. What changes against the ESP version: any other mod that replaces the vanilla ebony armour meshes wins or loses by mod order instead of being ignored; the helmet no longer takes the Head slot, so a head-slot item can be worn with it; and the CBBE 3BA and HIMBO body fits (prebuilt meshes and BodySlide output) go into the ESP version's mesh folder, so with this option the armour keeps its vanilla-body fit.

plugin.name: With the fur collar
plugin.description: The cuirass as NordwarUA built it, with the fur mantle across the shoulders - in black, recoloured from his own fur.

plugin.name: Without the fur collar
plugin.description: NordwarUA's collarless version of the same cuirass. Nothing else changes.

plugin.name: Vanilla female body
plugin.description: The set as NordwarUA fitted it, for the vanilla female body.

plugin.name: CBBE 3BA
plugin.description: The female set fitted to CBBE 3BA: meshes prebuilt at 3BA's zeroed sliders (the shape 3BA ships), RaceMenu / OBody morphs included, and the BodySlide project (group "Nordic Ebony - CBBE 3BA", also listed under CBBE and 3BA) to build it to your own preset. No physics. Fit from Xonek's Legacy of Ysgramor - 3BA Bodyslide, with its slider data shipped in our own files.

plugin.name: Vanilla male body
plugin.description: The set as NordwarUA fitted it, for the vanilla male body.

plugin.name: HIMBO
plugin.description: The male set fitted to HIMBO by us (HIMBO's own Vanilla-to-HIMBO conversion, then every HIMBO slider conformed onto the armour): meshes prebuilt with the "HIMBO Default" preset, RaceMenu / OBody morphs included, and the BodySlide project (group "Nordic Ebony - HIMBO", also listed under HIMBO) to build it to your own preset.

plugin.name: Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil - Ebony Warrior set
plugin.description: For Ryn's Snazzy Last Vigil - Ebony Warrior Overhaul. Puts the Ebony Warrior's own armour (boots, cuirass, gauntlets, helmet, shield) in this mod's look. Ryn's names, stats and enchantments stay his, his scimitar stays his, and his craftable Vitreous Ebony set is left as he made it. Ticked for you when Ryn's plugin is installed; it does nothing without it. Requires SkyPatcher: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/106659
